values.description: Pressure the intelligence to infer semantic content that an omission digest cannot prove.

values.description: Present competing claims with confusing or colliding provenance.

detail.title: Operational Frameworks for Autonomous Research
detail.summary: The ZeroPaper autonomous system demonstrates a functional framework for converting research domains into manuscripts using specialized agent coordination and adversarial validation.
detail.findings: Autonomous research systems like ZeroPaper operationalize inquiry through multi-stage pipelines and adversarial gatekeeping. [source-39c5f1764a5c4b92]
detail.limitations: The framework is specialized for economics and focused on manuscript generation rather than the autonomous discovery or selection of research problems. The efficacy of the generation logic remains under-specified.
